title: SARS-CoV-2 Sequencing Protocol Using Illumina Nextera Flex & MiSeqNEB - Part 2
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol is a semi-automated workflow which performs 8.1-8.4.6 of the SARS-CoV-2 Using Illumina Nextera Flex & MiSeqNEB kit. For detailed information on protocol steps, please see below. You can find part 1 of the protocol here: * [SARS-CoV-2 Using Illumina Nextera Flex & MiSeqNEB - Part 1](https://protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/5b16ef) Explanation of complex parameters below: * `Number of Sample Columns (1-6)`: Specify how many sample columns (1-6) this run will process. Samples will be placed in every other column, starting from column 1 (i.e. 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 for 6 columns). * `csv`: csv should be formatted in the following order, including the header line (also be sure to skip columns): ``` Well, DNA Volume (ul), Pool Volume A1, 5, 5 B1, 3, 5 C1, 5, 5 D1, 5, 5 E1, 2, 5 F1, 5, 5 G1, 5, 5 H1, 4, 5 A3, 5, 5 ``` * `Index Start Column (1-12)`: Specify which column in the index plate to begin aspirating from. Note: the number of index columns left should be greater or equal to the number of sample columns. If not, the protocol will throw an error at the beginning of the run. * `P20 Multi-Channel Mount`: Specify which mount (left or right) to host the P20 and P300 multi-channel pipettes. ---

Magnets are engaged for 3 minutes, 60ul of supernatant removed from wells at half aspiration rate so as not to disturb the beads. Furthermore, aspirations take place on the side of the well opposite magnetically engaged beads to avoid disturbing the beads.

Protocol pauses with the following message: "Seal the plate with Microseal A. Run the following preprogrammed settings on the thermal cycler with a headed lid (100C). Program "Flex Amp" on the thermal cycler. Ensure a fresh 96 well bio-rad plate is in slot 4 of the deck. Select "Resume" on the Opentron App. Empty trash if needed."
Magnetic module is engaged for 5 minutes.
32ul of RSB is added to samples.
Protocol pauses with message "Ensure a fresh 96 well bio-rad plate is in slot 4 of the deck. Select "Resume" on the Opentron App. Empty trash if needed."
Samples are pooled with volumes provided by csv.

steps.title: Normalize DNA with water
steps.instruction: Using the P20 multi‑channel pipette with a single tip, add the specified volume of water to empty wells of the final plate on slot 4, then add the DNA from the source plate on slot 1 to those wells (samples are placed in every other column, matching the source plate).

steps.title: Add tagmentation mastermix
steps.instruction: Dispense 20 µL of tagment mastermix into each sample well and mix by pipetting up and down three times.

steps.title: Seal and tagmentation thermal cycle
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a Microseal B, place it in a thermal cycler with the lid heated to 100 °C, run the "Flex Tag" program: 55 °C for 15 min then hold at 10 °C. After the run, return the plate to slot 4 and resume the protocol for post‑tagmentation cleanup. Empty trash if needed.

steps.title: Add and mix TSB
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL of premixed TSB to each well and mix immediately after dispensing.

steps.title: Seal and post‑tagmentation incubation
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a Microseal A, place it in a thermal cycler (lid 100 °C) and run the "Flex Post" program: 37 °C for 15 min then hold at 10 °C. After the run, spin the plate, move it onto the magnetic module, and resume the protocol for washing. Empty trash if needed.

steps.title: Engage magnets and aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 3 min, then aspirate 60 µL of supernatant from each well at half aspiration speed, drawing from the side opposite the beads to avoid disturbance.

steps.title: Wash beads with TWB
steps.instruction: Perform three washes with 100 µL of TWB per well, removing the supernatant after each wash; after the final wash leave the 100 µL TWB in the wells to prevent bead drying.

steps.title: Load PCR mastermix
steps.instruction: Ensure the PCR mastermix is placed on the deck as indicated, then resume the protocol. Empty trash if needed.

steps.title: Add PCR mastermix and mix
steps.instruction: Remove the remaining TWB supernatant, add 40 µL of PCR mastermix to each well, and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add indexes to samples
steps.instruction: Using a set of tips, puncture the foil of the index plate, discard those tips, pick up new tips, aspirate 10 µL of each index, dispense into the corresponding sample wells, and perform 10 mixing repetitions.

steps.title: Seal and PCR thermal cycle
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with a Microseal A, place a fresh 96‑well Bio‑Rad plate in slot 4, run the "Flex Amp" program on a thermal cycler with lid at 100 °C, then resume the protocol. Empty trash if needed.

steps.title: Engage magnets for post‑PCR
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to new plate
steps.instruction: Aspirate 45 µL of supernatant from each sample well and dispense into the corresponding wells of the 96‑well plate located in slot 4.

steps.title: Discard plate and resume
steps.instruction: Discard the used plate on the magnetic module, move the plate from slot 4 to the magnetic module, and resume the protocol. Empty trash if needed.

steps.title: Add SPB and mix
steps.instruction: Aspirate 81 µL of SPB slowly, pause 3 seconds after aspiration, dispense into each sample well, and mix by pipetting up and down ten times.

steps.title: Incubate at room temperature
steps.instruction: Allow the plate to sit at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Wash beads with ethanol
steps.instruction: Perform two washes with 200 µL of ethanol per well, removing the ethanol after each wash.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Delay the protocol for 5 minutes to let the beads air‑dry, then automatically resume.

steps.title: Add RSB to samples
steps.instruction: Dispense 32 µL of RSB into each well.

steps.title: Incubate with RSB and magnet
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 3 minutes, engage the magnets, then delay an additional 3.5 minutes before proceeding.

steps.title: Load fresh plate and resume
steps.instruction: Place a fresh 96‑well Bio‑Rad plate in slot 4, then resume the protocol. Empty trash if needed.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to slot 4
steps.instruction: Aspirate 30 µL of supernatant from each sample well and dispense into the corresponding wells of the plate in slot 4, skipping every other column as defined.

steps.title: Pool samples per CSV
steps.instruction: Pool the samples according to the volumes specified in the CSV file.
